187	    Decidable (NewArenaPre s arenas others storage internal) :=
188	  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
189	    Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal)
190	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
191	
192	/-- Effect of `newArena` (§76, `ok` effect): a live entry is added, `available` holding the leaves
193	of the storage and `issued` empty; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
194	def newArenaEff (L : LState) (storage internal : Nat) : LState :=
195	  { L with arenas := L.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint L.kern.P storage, []⟩] }
196	
197	/-- `newArena` as a relation (§76, §58): `ok` or `reject`; `others` are the other registries of
198	live administrations consulted by the guard (§56). -/
199	def NewArenaStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : LState) :
200	    Outcome3 LState → Prop :=
201	  Guarded (NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas others storage internal) (newArenaEff L storage internal)
202	
203	/-! ## O18 `issue` (§77) -/
204	
205	/-- Static preconditions of `issue(arena, region, destination)` (§77.1, §77.2). The static
206	restrictions of §77.3 are given no list by the text and are not represented. -/
207	structure IssueStatic (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
208	  /-- §77.1: the entry is live; `internal` is active. -/
209	  live : s.Active E.internal
210	  /-- §77.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
211	  metaRight : MetaRight s E
212	  /-- §77.2: `region` belongs to the administered storage. -/
213	  regionIn : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
214	  /-- §77.2: `destination` is usable. -/
215	  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
216	  /-- §77.2: `destination` is a leaf. -/
217	  dstLeaf : isLeaf s.P dst
218	  /-- §77.2: `destination` holds no active authority. -/
219	  dstFree : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
220	    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True
221	  /-- §77.2: `destination` can legally receive the block value in mode `Modify`. -/
222	  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
223	  /-- §77.2: local self-blocking prevention, `destination` is not in `region`. -/
224	  dstNotIn : dst ∉ region
225	
226	/-- Decidability of `IssueStatic` (§77). -/
227	instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
228	    Decidable (IssueStatic s E region dst) :=
229	  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
230	    (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
231	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
232	      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True) ∧
233	    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ dst ∉ region)
234	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
235	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩
236	
237	/-- §77.5: the effective mode of `internal` permits `Modify` on every leaf of the region. -/
238	def IssueRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
239	  ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s E.internal l) .modify
240	
241	/-- Decidability of `IssueRight` (§77.5). -/
242	instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s E region) := by
243	  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance
244	
245	/-- Kernel part of the effect of `issue` (§77, `ok` effect): a block authority of fresh identity
246	`|A|`, derived from `internal`, of mode `Modify`, on the region, held by `destination`, which
247	receives the corresponding anchor; only leaf `destination` becomes `Init`. -/
248	def issueKEff (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 :=
249	  { s with
250	    A := s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩]
251	    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ [s.A.length] else s.D q
252	    I := fun l => if l = dst then .init else s.I l }
253	
254	/-- Metadata part of the effect of `issue` (§77, `ok` effect; §46): the leaves of the region leave
255	`available`; the issuance joins `issued` with its authority. -/
256	def issueMeta (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : ArenaEntry :=
257	  { E with
258	    available := E.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
259	    issued := (region, s.A.length) :: E.issued }
260	
261	/-- Checks of `issue` on the simulated resulting state (§77.3, §77.6). -/
262	structure IssueArrival (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
263	  /-- §77.3: `AnchorOrder` for the new anchor of `destination`, in the resulting state. -/
264	  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK (issueKEff s E region dst) s.A.length
265	    ((issueKEff s E region dst).pframe dst)
266	  /-- §77.6: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
267	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (issueKEff s E region dst)
268	  /-- §77.6, O8.5: `destination` remains under exercisable `Modify` in the resulting state. -/
269	  keepsDst : HasRight (issueKEff s E region dst) .modify dst
270	
271	/-- Decidability of `IssueArrival` (§77). -/
272	instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
273	    Decidable (IssueArrival s E region dst) :=
274	  decidable_of_iff (EffAnchorOK (issueKEff s E region dst) s.A.length
275	      ((issueKEff s E region dst).pframe dst) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (issueKEff s E region dst) ∧
276	    HasRight (issueKEff s E region dst) .modify dst)
277	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩
278	
279	/-- Library state after an `ok` issue of entry `i` (§77, `ok` effect). -/
280	def issueL (L : LState) (i : Nat) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : LState :=
281	  ⟨issueKEff L.kern E region dst, L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E region)⟩
282	
283	/-- The contract of `issue` on entry `i` (§77, §58): `reject` when the entry is missing or a
284	static precondition fails; `fail`, the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable (§77.4);
285	`reject` when the effective right (§77.5) or a check on the resulting state (§77.3, §77.6)
286	fails; `ok` otherwise. -/
287	inductive IssueC (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (L : LState) :
288	    Outcome3 LState → Prop where
289	  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → IssueC i region dst L .reject
290	  | static {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
291	      IssueC i region dst L .reject
292	  | fail {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
293	      ¬ Avail E region → IssueC i region dst L .fail
294	  | noRight {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
295	      Avail E region → ¬ IssueRight L.kern E region → IssueC i region dst L .reject
296	  | noArrival {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
297	      Avail E region → IssueRight L.kern E region → ¬ IssueArrival L.kern E region dst →
298	      IssueC i region dst L .reject
299	  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
300	      Avail E region → IssueRight L.kern E region → IssueArrival L.kern E region dst →
301	      IssueC i region dst L (.ok (issueL L i E region dst))
302	
303	/-- `issue` as a derived operation (Part XIV, §77): its static checks, then the availability
304	`fail` (§77.4), then `split` of `internal` on the region (O2) and `store` of the block, of fresh
305	identity `|A|`, into the destination (O8); the metadata is updated on `ok`. -/
306	inductive IssueD (k : K) (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (L : LState) :
307	    Outcome3 LState → Prop where
308	  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
309	  | static {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
310	      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
311	  | fail {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
312	      ¬ Avail E region → IssueD k i region dst L .fail
313	  | split {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
314	      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern .reject →
315	      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
316	  | store {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
317	      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
318	      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
319	  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
320	      IssueStatic L.kern E region dst → Avail E region →
321	      SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
322	      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
323	      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E region)⟩)
324	
325	/-! ## O19 `reset` (§78) -/
326	
327	/-- §78.3: no still-usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of
328	`internal`. Dependencies of contained values are covered since parts are places. -/
329	def ResetNoDeps (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
330	  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, E.internal ∉ s.ancs x
331	
332	/-- Decidability of `ResetNoDeps` (§78.3). -/
333	instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetNoDeps s E) := by
334	  unfold ResetNoDeps; infer_instance
335	
336	/-- Preconditions of `reset(arena)` (§78). "`internal` and the arena's other restrictions remain
337	valid" (§78.1) and "validity obligations of other nested arenas remain satisfied" (§78.3) name no
338	checkable condition beyond `ArenaInv` and are not represented. -/
339	structure ResetPre (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
340	  /-- §78.1: the entry is live. -/
341	  live : s.Active E.internal
342	  /-- §78.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
343	  metaRight : MetaRight s E
344	  /-- §78.2: no active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the storage. -/
345	  noCover : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
346	    ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage
347	  /-- §78.3: no usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of `internal`. -/
348	  noDeps : ResetNoDeps s E
349	
350	/-- Decidability of `ResetPre` (§78). -/
351	instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetPre s E) :=
352	  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
353	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
354	      ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ ResetNoDeps s E)
355	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩
356	
357	/-- Kernel part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, Part XIV): the record of the `Modify`
358	derivation of `internal` over all the storage, already released; no leaf becomes `Init`. -/
359	def resetKEff (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : S3 :=
360	  { s with A := s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, footprint s.P E.storage, .frame s.top, false⟩] }
361	
362	/-- Metadata part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, §46): all leaves of the storage
363	become available; `issued` is cleared. -/
364	def resetMeta (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : ArenaEntry :=
365	  { E with available := footprint s.P E.storage, issued := [] }
366	
367	/-- Library state after an `ok` reset of entry `i` (§78). -/
368	def resetL (L : LState) (i : Nat) (E : ArenaEntry) : LState :=
369	  ⟨resetKEff L.kern E, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩
370	
371	/-- The contract of `reset` on entry `i` (§78, §58): `ok` when the entry exists and the
372	preconditions hold, `reject` otherwise. -/
373	inductive ResetC (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
374	  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetC i L .reject
375	  | reject {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ ResetPre L.kern E → ResetC i L .reject
376	  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ResetPre L.kern E →
377	      ResetC i L (.ok (resetL L i E))
378	
379	/-- `reset` as a derived operation (Part XIV, §78): `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the
380	footprint of the storage (O1), `release` of the derived authority (O3), then the explicit contract
381	check of §78.3; the metadata is updated on `ok`. -/
382	inductive ResetD (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
383	  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetD i L .reject
384	  | derive {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
385	      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern .reject →
386	      ResetD i L .reject
387	  | release {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
388	      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
389	      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → ResetD i L .reject
390	  | contract {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
391	      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
392	      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ¬ ResetNoDeps L.kern E → ResetD i L .reject
393	  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
394	      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
395	      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ResetNoDeps L.kern E →
396	      ResetD i L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩)
397	
398	/-! ## Helper lemmas (§40, §42, §43, §65) -/
399	
400	/-- `Allows` at `Modify` is effective `Modify` (§43). -/
401	theorem allows_modify_iff {e : Option Mode} : Allows e .modify ↔ e = some .modify := by
402	  cases e with
403	  | none => simp [Allows, OptP]
404	  | some m => cases m <;> simp [Allows, OptP, Mode.le]
405	
406	/-- Effective `Modify` permits every requested mode (§43: `Observe ≤ Modify`). -/
407	theorem allows_some_modify (m : Mode) : Allows (some .modify) m := by
408	  cases m <;> simp [Allows, OptP, Mode.le]
409	
410	/-- An exercisable authority exists (§43). -/
411	theorem exercisable_lt {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : s.ExercisableAt a m) :
412	    a < s.A.length := by
413	  cases h <;> exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
414	
415	/-- An exercise at `Modify` is an exercise at every mode (§43: `Observe ≤ Modify`). -/
416	theorem exercisable_of_modify {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : s.ExercisableAt a .modify) :
417	    s.ExercisableAt a m := by
418	  generalize hm : Mode.modify = m' at h
419	  induction h with
420	  | base hy ha hle hf =>
421	    subst hm
422	    exact .base hy ha (.inr (hle.resolve_left (by decide))) hf
423	  | held hy ha hle hp _ hc ih =>
424	    subst hm
425	    exact .held hy ha (.inr (hle.resolve_left (by decide))) hp (ih rfl)
426	      fun l hl => by rw [allows_modify_iff.1 (hc l hl)]; exact allows_some_modify m
427	
428	/-- A permitted effective mode comes from an existing authority covering the leaf (§43,
429	case 1). -/
430	theorem mem_of_allows {s : S3} {a l : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : Allows (effective s a l) m) :
431	    ∃ x, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ l ∈ x.footprint := by
432	  unfold effective at h
433	  cases hx : s.A[a]? with
434	  | none => rw [hx] at h; exact h.elim
435	  | some x =>
436	    rw [hx] at h; simp only at h
437	    split at h
438	    · exact ⟨x, rfl, ‹_ ∧ _›.2⟩
439	    · exact h.elim
440	
441	/-- More covering descendants permit no more (§43, cases 2–4). -/
442	theorem allows_effOf_append {m m' : Mode} {ds e : List Mode}
443	    (h : Allows (effOf m (ds ++ e)) m') : Allows (effOf m ds) m' := by
444	  by_cases h0 : ds ++ e = []
445	  · rw [(List.append_eq_nil_iff.1 h0).1]; simpa [effOf, h0] using h
446	  · by_cases h1 : Mode.modify ∈ ds ++ e
447	    · simp [effOf, h0, h1, Allows, OptP] at h
448	    · have hm' : m' = .observe := by
449	        cases m' with
450	        | observe => rfl
451	        | modify => simp [effOf, h0, h1, Allows, OptP, Mode.le] at h
452	      subst hm'
453	      have h1' : Mode.modify ∉ ds := fun h' => h1 (List.mem_append_left _ h')
454	      by_cases hd : ds = []
455	      · simp [effOf, hd, Allows, OptP, Mode.le]
456	      · simp [effOf, hd, h1', Allows, OptP, Mode.le]
457	
458	/-- Adding an authority only takes effective modes away from the existing ones (§43,
459	case 3). -/
460	theorem allows_addAuth_back {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {b l : Nat} {m : Mode}
461	    (hb : b < s.A.length) (h : Allows (effective (s.addAuth y₀) b l) m) :
462	    Allows (effective s b l) m := by
463	  unfold effective at h ⊢
464	  rw [addAuth_lt hb, descModes_addAuth] at h
465	  cases hx : s.A[b]? with
466	  | none => rw [hx] at h; exact h
467	  | some x =>
468	    rw [hx] at h; simp only at h ⊢
469	    split at h
470	    · rename_i hc; simp only [hc, and_self, ite_true]; exact allows_effOf_append h
471	    · exact h.elim
472	
473	/-- Exercise after adding the block `y₀` of `src`, for a former authority, comes from an
474	exercise before: a link through the block is replaced by a link through `src` (§43). -/
475	theorem exercisable_addAuth_back {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {src : Nat}
476	    (hsrc : s.ExercisableAt src .modify)
477	    (hfp : ∀ l ∈ y₀.footprint, effective s src l = some .modify) {a : Nat} {m : Mode}
478	    (h : (s.addAuth y₀).ExercisableAt a m) : a < s.A.length → s.ExercisableAt a m := by
479	  induction h with
480	  | base hy ha hle hf =>
481	    intro hlt
482	    rw [addAuth_lt hlt] at hy
483	    exact .base hy ha hle hf
484	  | @held a' p b m' y hy ha hle hp hb hc ih =>
485	    intro hlt
486	    rw [addAuth_lt hlt] at hy
487	    by_cases hbl : b < s.A.length
488	    · exact .held hy ha hle hp (ih hbl) fun l hl => allows_addAuth_back hbl (hc l hl)
489	    · have hbe : b = s.A.length := by
490	        have := exercisable_lt hb; simp [S3.addAuth] at this; omega
491	      subst hbe
492	      refine .held hy ha hle hp (exercisable_of_modify hsrc) fun l hl => ?_
493	      obtain ⟨x, hx, hlx⟩ := mem_of_allows (hc l hl)
494	      rw [addAuth_self] at hx; cases hx
495	      rw [hfp l hlx]; exact allows_some_modify m'
496	
497	/-- `HasRight` after adding the block `y₀` of `src`, on a place none of whose leaves the block
498	covers, comes from `HasRight` before (§43). -/
499	theorem hasRight_addAuth_back {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {src p : Nat} {m : Mode}
500	    (hsrc : s.ExercisableAt src .modify)
501	    (hfp : ∀ l ∈ y₀.footprint, effective s src l = some .modify)
502	    (hout : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, l ∉ y₀.footprint) (h : HasRight (s.addAuth y₀) m p) :
503	    HasRight s m p := by
504	  obtain ⟨a, -, ha, hall⟩ := h
505	  by_cases hlt : a < s.A.length
506	  · exact ⟨a, List.mem_range.2 hlt, exercisable_addAuth_back hsrc hfp ha hlt,
507	      fun l hl => allows_addAuth_back hlt (hall l hl)⟩
508	  · have hae : a = s.A.length := by
509	      have := exercisable_lt ha; simp [S3.addAuth] at this; omega
510	    subst hae
511	    refine ⟨src, List.mem_range.2 (exercisable_lt hsrc), exercisable_of_modify hsrc,
512	      fun l hl => ?_⟩
513	    obtain ⟨x, hx, hlx⟩ := mem_of_allows (hall l hl)
514	    rw [addAuth_self] at hx; cases hx
515	    exact absurd hlx (hout l hl)
516	
517	/-- The effect of `store` on an existing authority (§65, `ok` effect). -/
518	theorem storeEff_eq {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) :
519	    storeEff s a p = { s with
520	      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic

/-!
# Access kernel: operations O1–O16

The sixteen kernel operations of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` §60–§75. Each
operation has a precondition structure with one named field per clause item (or per condition of
an item), each field citing its clause; a `Decidable` instance; an effect function; and a step
relation over `Outcome3` (§58). Every operation except `alloc` is `Guarded` (`ok` or `reject`);
`alloc` may also `fail` (§58, §71). `KStep` is the union of their `ok` transitions.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index counted from `i` (used by the
effects of §72 and §73). -/
def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
  | _, [] => []
  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l

/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/

/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩

/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §60.1: `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src m
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
  leaves : ∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src
  /-- §60.2: `mode` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m
  /-- §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50): an active authority outside the origin chain of the
  new one and sharing a leaf of `region` has own mode `Observe`, and so has the request. -/
  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
    True
  /-- §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
  frameLive : s.top ∈ s.F

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) :
    Decidable (DerivePre s src region m) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
      b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
      True) ∧
    s.top ∈ s.F)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩

/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority
per region, held by the current frame. -/
def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }

/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p` (§61.3): an active `Modify`
descendant of `src` covering `p`. -/
def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
    False

/-- Decidability of `DistribExcl` (§61.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `split` (§61). §61.4 is not a precondition (see the note of §61). -/
structure SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop where
  /-- §61.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §61.1: `source` is exercisable by the current frame in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src .modify
  /-- §61.1: sufficient modification rights: effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions. -/
  modifyOn : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify
  /-- §61.2: each region lies within the available footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none
  /-- §61.3: regions are pairwise disjoint, structurally or by `K.DeclaredDisjoint`. -/
  disjoint : rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
  /-- §61.3: no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped. -/
  notDistributed : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `split` (§61). -/
instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `split` as a relation (§61). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (§62) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (§62, `ok` effect): the authority becomes inactive and leaves
the anchors of its holding place. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (§62.2): the current frame itself, or a place on which
the current frame has exercisable `Modify`. -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of `HolderRight` (§62.2). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (§62). §62.5 is not represented. -/
structure ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §62.1: the authority is active. -/
  active : s.Active a
  /-- §62.1: the authority is derived. -/
  derived : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §62.2: it is held by the current frame or by a place with exercisable `Modify`. -/
  holderRight : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False
  /-- §62.3: no active descendant. -/
  noActiveDesc : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j
  /-- §62.3, §62.4: no usable place keeps `a` as anchor, except its holding place. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
    (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `release` (§62). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active a ∧ OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False ∧
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
      (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `release` as a relation (§62). -/
def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
/-! ## O8 `store` (§65) -/

/-- Effect of `store(authority, target)` (§65, `ok` effect): `target` becomes the holder, the
authority joins `D(target)`, and only leaf `target` becomes `Init`. -/
def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
  | none => s

/-- Preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
structure StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
  derivedHeld : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
    y.holder = .frame s.top) False
  /-- §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
  leaf : isLeaf s.P p
  /-- §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
  right : HasRight s .modify p
  /-- §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
  /-- §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns, transitively. -/
  noCover : ∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q
  /-- §65.4: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` relative to the frame of `target`. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p)
  /-- §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/
  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p
  /-- §65.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) :=
  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
      y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧ s.Usable p ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
    EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧
    AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩

/-- `store` as a relation (§65). -/
def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)

/-! ## Shapes (§47, §71.1, §72) -/

/-- A local shape as a shape whose elements have no owning element (§71.1, §72: locals and
allocated storage are owned by the receiving holder). -/

5	# Refinement of the access kernel into the elementary memory machine (spec v0, Part XVII)
6	
7	Source: `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`, §82 (items 1–8) with §10, §16, §17, §23.
8	
9	* A layout of places in allocations and its interface `LayoutWF` (§82.1, §23).
10	* The representation relation `Repr` between a kernel state (`Access.S3`) and an admissible state
11	  of the memory machine (`Machine.State`, §9) (§82.1, §82.3, §82.4, §82.5).
12	* For every kernel operation O1–O16, the sequence of raw operations that realizes its `ok` step,
13	  proven to be a sequence of `ok` raw steps that keeps `Repr` (§82 preamble, §82.2, §82.4, §82.5).
14	* Safe reads and writes (§82.2), lifetimes (§82.5), deallocation contracts (§82.4), pinned
15	  addresses (§82.6), exclusivity of bytes (§82.8), pointers written by `store` (§82.3).
16	* A simulation of runs from the initial state with parameters fixed once per run, and concrete
17	  runs checked by evaluation.
18	
19	The sequential fragment only (§18, §29): no theorem here says anything about concurrency.
20	-/

26	/-! ## Allocations of the memory machine (§9) -/
27	
28	/-- The allocation `i` of `s2` is registered and satisfies `p` (§9, §11 ¶2). -/
29	def AllocP (s2 : Machine.State) (i : Nat) (p : Machine.Alloc → Prop) : Prop :=
30	  ∃ a, s2.allocs i = some a ∧ p a
31	
32	/-- The allocation `i` of `s2` is registered and live (§9 ¶1, §17 ¶3). -/
33	abbrev LiveAlloc (s2 : Machine.State) (i : Nat) : Prop := AllocP s2 i (·.live = true)
34	
35	/-- Weakening of the property of a registered allocation (§9). -/
36	theorem AllocP.mono {s : Machine.State} {i : Nat} {p q : Machine.Alloc → Prop}
37	    (h : AllocP s i p) (hpq : ∀ a, p a → q a) : AllocP s i q :=
38	  let ⟨a, ha, hp⟩ := h; ⟨a, ha, hpq a hp⟩
39	
40	/-- Two properties of one registered allocation (§9). -/
41	theorem AllocP.and {s : Machine.State} {i : Nat} {p q : Machine.Alloc → Prop}
42	    (hp : AllocP s i p) (hq : AllocP s i q) : AllocP s i fun a => p a ∧ q a := by
43	  obtain ⟨a, ha, h1⟩ := hp
44	  obtain ⟨b, hb, h2⟩ := hq
45	  rw [ha] at hb; cases hb
46	  exact ⟨a, ha, h1, h2⟩
47	
48	/-- A registered allocation is below the counter of a state with fresh identities (§9 ¶7). -/
49	theorem AllocP.lt {s : Machine.State} (hwf : Machine.WF s) {i : Nat} {p : Machine.Alloc → Prop}
50	    (h : AllocP s i p) : i < s.next :=
51	  Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hle => by obtain ⟨a, ha, -⟩ := h; rw [hwf i hle] at ha; cases ha
52	
53	/-- Base address of the allocation `i` of `s2`, `0` if unregistered (§9 ¶1, §12 ¶1). -/
54	def baseOf (s2 : Machine.State) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((s2.allocs i).map (·.base)).getD 0
55	
56	/-- The base of a registered allocation (§9 ¶1). -/
57	theorem baseOf_of {s2 : Machine.State} {i : Nat} {a : Machine.Alloc} (h : s2.allocs i = some a) :
58	    baseOf s2 i = a.base := by
59	  simp [baseOf, h]

61	/-! ## Layout of places (§82.1, §23) -/
62	
63	/-- Layout of places (§82.1): place `q` occupies the range `L q` of the elementary memory machine:
64	an allocation identity, an offset and a length (§11 ¶1). A parameter fixed for a run, defined on
65	every index, present or future. Only the allocation of a non-leaf place is read. -/
66	abbrev Layout := Nat → Machine.Place
67	
68	/-- Layout interface in the states `s3`, `s2` (§82.1; §23 "a memory layout satisfying
69	`LayoutWF`"). The spec names `LayoutWF` without stating its clauses; the clauses below are the
70	guarantees §82.1 and §23 ask the layout to provide. No lower bound on lengths: a leaf may have
71	size zero (§71.1). -/
72	structure LayoutWF (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) : Prop where
73	  /-- §82.1 (parts): a structural part lies in the allocation of its parent. -/
74	  parts : ∀ q r, parentOf s3.P q = some r → (L q).alloc = (L r).alloc
75	  /-- §23, §82.1 (disjointness): two distinct leaves in one allocation have disjoint ranges. -/
76	  disjoint : ∀ l l', l < s3.P.length → l' < s3.P.length → isLeaf s3.P l → isLeaf s3.P l' →
77	    l ≠ l' → (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc →
78	    Machine.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len
79	  /-- §82.1, §15 ¶1: the range of a leaf lies within its allocation, which is registered. -/
80	  within : ∀ l, l < s3.P.length → isLeaf s3.P l →
81	    AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size
82	
83	/-- Elements of a parent chain lie in the allocation of its start (§82.1 parts, §40). -/
84	theorem alloc_chainF {L : Layout} {P : List Place}
85	    (hp : ∀ q r, parentOf P q = some r → (L q).alloc = (L r).alloc) :
86	    ∀ k i r, r ∈ chainF (parentOf P) k i → (L i).alloc = (L r).alloc
87	  | 0, _, _, h => by simp [chainF] at h
88	  | k + 1, i, r, h => by
89	    simp only [chainF] at h
90	    split at h
91	    · rename_i o ho
92	      split at h
93	      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
94	        · exact hp i _ ho
95	        · exact (hp i o ho).trans (alloc_chainF hp k o r h)
96	      · simp at h
97	    · simp at h
98	
99	/-- A part lies in the allocation of every place it belongs to (§82.1 parts, §40). -/
100	theorem LayoutWF.alloc_part {L : Layout} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} (hl : LayoutWF L s3 s2)
101	    {l r : Nat} (h : partOf s3.P l r) : (L l).alloc = (L r).alloc := by
102	  rcases h.2 with rfl | h
103	  · rfl
104	  · exact alloc_chainF hl.parts l l r h

106	/-! ## Representation relation (§82.1, §82.3, §82.4, §82.5, §9) -/
107	
108	/-- Representation relation between a kernel state `s3` and a state `s2` of the memory machine,
109	for the layout `L` and the deallocation tokens `rtok` recorded for the allocation of each root
110	place (`rtok r` for the root place `r`; §17 ¶4, §70.2):
111	- `adm`: `s2` is admissible (§9 ¶8: freshness, live disjointness, alignment);
112	- `layout`: the layout interface (§82.1, §23);
113	- `inj`: two distinct root places are in distinct allocations (§82.1: storage units and
114	  identities; §9 ¶5: subplaces are not new allocations, so parts share their root's);
115	- `tokens`: the allocation of a root place is registered and records the token `rtok r`
116	  (§82.4, §17 ¶4);
117	- `live`: the allocation of a usable root place is live (§82.5);
118	- `init`: the bytes of the range of an `Init` leaf are initialized (§82.3; `Uninit` and `Moved`
119	  impose nothing, §41).
120	It does not read the contract `K` (§48). -/
121	structure Repr (L : Layout) (rtok : Nat → Nat) (s3 : S3) (s2 : Machine.State) : Prop where
122	  /-- §9 ¶8: admissibility of the memory state. -/
123	  adm : Machine.Admissible s2
124	  /-- §82.1, §23: layout interface. -/
125	  layout : LayoutWF L s3 s2
126	  /-- §82.1, §9 ¶5: distinct root places, distinct allocations. -/
127	  inj : ∀ r r', RootPlace s3.P r → RootPlace s3.P r' → r ≠ r' → (L r).alloc ≠ (L r').alloc
128	  /-- §82.4, §17 ¶4: the allocation of a root place is registered with the token `rtok r`. -/
129	  tokens : ∀ r, RootPlace s3.P r → AllocP s2 (L r).alloc fun a => a.freeAuth = some (rtok r)
130	  /-- §82.5: the allocation of a usable root place is live. -/
131	  live : ∀ r, RootPlace s3.P r → s3.Usable r → LiveAlloc s2 (L r).alloc
132	  /-- §82.3: the range of an `Init` leaf is initialized. -/
133	  init : ∀ l, l < s3.P.length → isLeaf s3.P l → s3.I l = .init →
134	    AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len

140	variable {Ty : Type}
141	
142	/-- Effect of an `ok` raw operation (§20.2): a read leaves the state unchanged. -/
143	def opEff : Machine.Op Ty → Machine.State → Machine.State
144	  | .read _ _, s => s
145	  | .write ac _ w, s => s.write ac w
146	  | .dealloc id _, s => s.dealloc id
147	  | .alloc sp b sz al fa, s => s.alloc sp b sz al fa
148	
149	/-- State after a sequence of `ok` raw operations (§20.3 ¶3). -/
150	def run : Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty) → Machine.State
151	  | s, [] => s
152	  | s, o :: os => run (opEff o s) os
153	
154	/-- `p s o` holds for each operation `o` of the sequence in the state where it runs (§20.3). -/
155	def Along (p : Machine.State → Machine.Op Ty → Prop) :
156	    Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty) → Prop
157	  | _, [] => True
158	  | s, o :: os => p s o ∧ Along p (opEff o s) os
159	
160	/-- Decidability of `Along` for a decidable property (§20.3 ¶3). -/
161	instance decAlong (p : Machine.State → Machine.Op Ty → Prop) [h : ∀ s o, Decidable (p s o)] :
162	    (s : Machine.State) → (os : List (Machine.Op Ty)) → Decidable (Along p s os)
163	  | _, [] => isTrue trivial
164	  | s, o :: os => @instDecidableAnd _ _ (h s o) (decAlong p (opEff o s) os)
165	
166	/-- The parametric obligations of a raw read or write hold, both parts (§15 ¶5, §16 ¶4,
167	§20.3 ¶1): explicit predicates of the execution context, never replaced by `True`. -/
168	def Obl (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (s : Machine.State) :
169	    Machine.Op Ty → Prop
170	  | .read ac t => ObR.dec s ac t ∧ ObR.stat s ac t
171	  | .write ac t w => ObW.dec s ac t w ∧ ObW.stat s ac t w
172	  | _ => True
173	
174	/-- The parametric obligations hold for every read and write of a sequence, in the state where it
175	runs (§20.3). -/
176	abbrev OblAlong (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) :
177	    Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty) → Prop :=
178	  Along (Obl ObR ObW)
179	
180	/-- The operation is an `ok` raw step from `s` to its effect (§20.1 ¶2). -/
181	def OkAt (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty) (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty)
182	    (s : Machine.State) (o : Machine.Op Ty) : Prop :=
183	  Machine.Step C ObR ObW o s (opEff o s)
184	
185	/-- A sequence of operations each `ok` where it runs is an execution (§20.3 ¶3). -/
186	theorem exec_of_along {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
187	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} :
188	    ∀ (os : List (Machine.Op Ty)) (s : Machine.State), Along (OkAt C ObR ObW) s os →
189	      Machine.Exec C ObR ObW os s (run s os)
190	  | [], s, _ => .nil s
191	  | _ :: os, _, ⟨h, hs⟩ => .cons h (exec_of_along os _ hs)
192	
193	/-- Composition of sequences (§20.3 ¶3). -/
194	theorem run_append (s : Machine.State) (os os' : List (Machine.Op Ty)) :
195	    run s (os ++ os') = run (run s os) os' := by
196	  induction os generalizing s with
197	  | nil => rfl
198	  | cons o os ih => exact ih _

496	raw read of the range of each leaf read is `ok` when the parametric obligations of that read hold
497	(§15.4, §15.6, §15.7): its allocation is live, the range is initialized, and the read returns the
498	bytes of the range. -/
499	theorem r1_read {Ty : Type} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty} {ty : Nat → Ty} {L : Layout}
500	    {rtok : Nat → Nat} {s3 : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat}
501	    (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2) (hw : WF3 s3) (hpre : Read3Pre s3 a ls) {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ ls)
502	    (hob : ObR.dec s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) ∧ ObR.stat s2 (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l)) :
503	    ∃ al, s2.allocs (L l).alloc = some al ∧ al.live = true ∧ al.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len ∧
504	      Machine.ReadStep ObR (leafAcc s2 L .read l) (ty l) s2
505	        (.ok (al.bytesAt (L l).off (L l).len)) := by
506	  obtain ⟨hlP, hlf, hu⟩ := leaf_of_leafOfUsable hw (hpre.usable l hl)
507	  obtain ⟨al, hal, hlive, hsz⟩ := hR.leaf_live hw hlP hlf hu
508	  obtain ⟨al', hal', hi⟩ := hR.init l hlP hlf (hpre.init l hl)
509	  rw [hal] at hal'; cases hal'
510	  refine ⟨al, hal, hlive, hi, ?_⟩
511	  have hc := canRead_leaf hal hlive hsz hi
512	  have hst := Machine.ReadStep.ok (ObR := ObR) (t := ty l) hal ⟨hc, hob.1, hob.2⟩

514	  simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using hst

527	    {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hR : Repr L rtok s3 s2)
528	    (hw : WF3 s3) (h : Read3Step a ls s3 (.ok s3'))
529	    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) :
530	    Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (readOps s2 L ty ls) s2 (run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) ∧
531	      run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls) = s2 ∧ Repr L rtok s3' (run s2 (readOps s2 L ty ls)) := by

572	raw write per leaf, of the range of the leaf, at the type `ty l`, of the representation `w l`
573	supplied by the program (§10 ¶4, §16 ¶2). -/

578	/-- The writes of the ranges of leaves whose allocations are live and contain them are `ok` under
579	their parametric obligations (§16, §82.2), and afterwards every written range is initialized
580	(§16 ¶2). -/
581	theorem writes_ok {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
582	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout} {ty : Nat → Ty}
583	    {w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat} :
584	    ∀ (ls : List Nat) (s2 : Machine.State), Machine.WF s2 →
585	      (∀ l ∈ ls, AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ a.size) →
586	      OblAlong ObR ObW s2 (writeOps s2 L ty w ls) →
587	      Along (OkAt C ObR ObW) s2 (writeOps s2 L ty w ls) ∧
588	        ∀ l ∈ ls, AllocP (run s2 (writeOps s2 L ty w ls)) (L l).alloc
589	          fun a => a.InitRange (L l).off (L l).len
590	  | [], _, _, _, _ => ⟨trivial, fun _ h => nomatch h⟩
591	  | l :: ls, s2, hwf, hls, hob => by
592	    obtain ⟨al, hal, hlive, hsz⟩ := hls l (List.mem_cons_self ..)
593	    have hex : AllocP s2 (L l).alloc fun _ => True := ⟨al, hal, trivial⟩
594	    have hd₁ : Dom s2 (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)) :=
595	      dom_opEff (Ty := Ty) hwf (.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (ty l) (w l))
596	    have hwf₁ : Machine.WF (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)) :=
597	      Machine.write_wf hwf _ _
598	    have hops : writeOps (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)) L ty w ls =
599	        writeOps s2 L ty w ls := by
600	      simp only [writeOps, List.map_inj_left]
601	      intro l' hl'
602	      obtain ⟨b, hb, -⟩ := hls l' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl')
603	      rw [leafAcc_dom hd₁ ⟨b, hb, trivial⟩]
604	    have hls₁ : ∀ l' ∈ ls, AllocP (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)) (L l').alloc
605	        fun a => a.live = true ∧ (L l').off + (L l').len ≤ a.size := by
606	      intro l' hl'
607	      obtain ⟨b, hb, hbl, hbs⟩ := hls l' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hl')
608	      obtain ⟨b', hb', -, e, -⟩ := hd₁ _ b hb
609	      refine ⟨b', hb', ?_, e ▸ hbs⟩
610	      have := live_opEff (Ty := Ty) (o := .write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (ty l) (w l)) hwf trivial
611	        ⟨b, hb, hbl⟩
612	      obtain ⟨b'', hb'', hl''⟩ := this
613	      change (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)).allocs _ = _ at hb''
614	      rw [hb'] at hb''; cases hb''; exact hl''
615	    have hob₁ : OblAlong ObR ObW (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l))
616	        (writeOps (s2.write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)) L ty w ls) := by
617	      rw [hops]; exact hob.2
618	    obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := writes_ok (C := C) ls _ hwf₁ hls₁ hob₁
619	    rw [hops] at ih1 ih2
620	    refine ⟨⟨.write (.ok ⟨canWrite_leaf hal hlive hsz, hob.1⟩), ih1⟩, fun l' hl' => ?_⟩
621	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hl' with rfl | hl'
622	    · exact (write_leaf_init hex).dom_init (dom_run _ _ hwf₁)
623	    · exact ih2 l' hl'

779	/-- Deallocations of distinct live allocations recording their tokens are `ok` when each token is
780	compatible with itself (§17.1, §17.2); afterwards they are dead and every other allocation is
781	unchanged (§17 ¶3). -/
782	theorem deallocOps_run {Ty : Type} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
783	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {L : Layout} {rtok : Nat → Nat}
784	    (htc : ∀ r, C (rtok r) (rtok r)) :
785	    ∀ (rs : List Nat) (s2 : Machine.State), rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (L r).alloc ≠ (L r').alloc) →
786	      (∀ r ∈ rs, AllocP s2 (L r).alloc fun a => a.live = true ∧ a.freeAuth = some (rtok r)) →
787	      Along (OkAt C ObR ObW) s2 (deallocOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok rs) ∧
788	      (∀ i, (∀ r ∈ rs, (L r).alloc ≠ i) →
789	        (run s2 (deallocOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok rs)).allocs i = s2.allocs i) ∧
790	      ∀ r ∈ rs, AllocP (run s2 (deallocOps (Ty := Ty) L rtok rs)) (L r).alloc (·.live = false)
791	  | [], _, _, _ => ⟨trivial, fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ h => nomatch h⟩
792	  | r :: rs, s2, hp, hrs => by
793	    obtain ⟨hr, hp⟩ := List.pairwise_cons.1 hp
794	    obtain ⟨a, ha, hla, hfa⟩ := hrs r (List.mem_cons_self ..)
795	    have hrs' : ∀ r' ∈ rs, AllocP (s2.dealloc (L r).alloc) (L r').alloc
796	        fun a => a.live = true ∧ a.freeAuth = some (rtok r') := fun r' hr' => by
797	      obtain ⟨b, hb, hbl⟩ := hrs r' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr')
798	      refine ⟨b, ?_, hbl⟩
799	      rw [dealloc_allocs, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm (hr r' hr')), hb]
800	    obtain ⟨ih1, ih2, ih3⟩ := deallocOps_run htc rs _ hp hrs'
801	    refine ⟨⟨.dealloc (.ok ⟨a, ha, hla, _, hfa, htc r⟩), ih1⟩, fun i hi => ?_, fun r' hr' => ?_⟩
802	    · change (run (s2.dealloc (L r).alloc) (deallocOps L rtok rs)).allocs i = _
803	      rw [ih2 i fun r' hr' => hi r' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr'), dealloc_allocs,
804	        ite_eq_right (Ne.symm (hi r (List.mem_cons_self ..)))]
805	    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 hr' with rfl | hr'
806	      · refine ⟨{ a with live := false }, ?_, rfl⟩
807	        change (run (s2.dealloc (L r').alloc) (deallocOps L rtok rs)).allocs _ = _
808	        rw [ih2 _ fun r'' hr'' => Ne.symm (hr r'' hr''), dealloc_allocs, ite_eq_left rfl, ha]
809	        rfl
810	      · exact ih3 r' hr'

853	    cases hpl : s3.P[r]? with

855	    | some pl =>

857	      exact (hR.live r hrt (.frame hpl hd ho (top_mem hF))).and (hR.tokens r hrt)

861	    (fun r hr hu => ?_) fun l _ _ hi => .inl hi⟩
862	  have hu0 : s3.Usable r := S3.Usable.mono (s := s3) (s' := exitEff s3) rfl

865	    obtain ⟨-, ho, -⟩ := mem_exitRoots.1 hm
866	    have hnd := hw.frames.2.1

868	    | frame hpl _ ho' hf =>

870	      rw [hpl] at ho; simp only [OptP] at ho; rw [ho] at ho'; cases ho'

875	      | cons f F =>

882	  refine ⟨a, ?_, hla⟩

2137	of the static leaves (§47, §10 ¶5). -/

2139	  /-- §82.1: layout of the places. -/
2140	  L : Layout
2141	  /-- §17 ¶4, §82.4: token recorded for the allocation of each root place. -/
2142	  rtok : Nat → Nat

2146	  geom : Nat → Geom

2148	  ty : Nat → Ty

2150	  pe : PtrEnc

2155	recorded token compatible with itself (the automatic deallocation at `exitFrame` presents the
2156	recorded token, §73, §82.5). -/

2158	  PlacementOK π.pl ∧ GeomOK π.geom ∧ ∀ r, C (π.rtok r) (π.rtok r)

2165	  | .enter _ ls, s3, s2 => allocOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok s3.P.length s2 (rootIdx ls.toShape)
2166	  | .exit, s3, _ => exitOps π.L π.rtok s3
2167	  | .read _ ls, _, s2 => readOps s2 π.L π.ty ls
2168	  | .write _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L π.ty w ls
2169	  | .writeShared _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L π.ty w ls

2183	    match op with

2185	    | .alloc _ ow ls => NewLayout π.L (allocP s3 ow ls) s3.P.length s2.next π.geom
2186	        (rootIdx ls.toShape)

2203	  cases op with

2205	  | split => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_split hR h⟩
2206	  | release => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_release hR h⟩
2207	  | transfer => exact r6_transfer hR hw h hob
2208	  | depend => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_depend hR h⟩
2209	  | enter => exact r6_enter hR hw h hpl hg hx
2210	  | exit =>
2211	    have := r6_exit (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) hR hw h htc
2212	    exact ⟨this.1, this.2.2⟩
2213	  | read =>
2214	    have := r6_read (C := C) hR hw h hob
2215	    exact ⟨this.1, this.2.2⟩
2216	  | write => exact r2_write hR hw h hob
2217	  | writeShared => exact r2_writeShared hR hw h hob
2218	  | pin => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_pin hR h⟩
2219	  | unpin => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_unpin hR h⟩
2220	  | endUse => exact ⟨.nil _, r6_endUse hR h⟩

2224	  | alloc => exact (r6_alloc hR hw h hpl hg hx).2

2230	contract `K`, the deallocation compatibility `C`, the obligations `ObR`, `ObW` and the parameters
2231	`π` fixed once for the run (§20.3 ¶3, §82): the initial state with the creations and writes of the
2232	statics (`repr_init`); then each `ok` kernel step from a state satisfying `WF3` and `NoDangling`
2233	(parts of the kernel invariant, §57) under its obligations, followed by its raw operations. The
2234	invariant is a hypothesis on the states of the run, not a consequence of reachability, since
2235	`transfer` can break it (an ownership cycle, §63 against §49.8 and §54). -/
2236	inductive SimRun {Ty : Type} (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
2237	    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (statics : Statics) (π : Params Ty) :
2238	    S3 → Machine.State → Prop where
2239	  | init : StaticsOK statics →
2240	      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →
2241	      OblAlong ObR ObW (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0
2242	        Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) (writeOps (run Machine.State.empty
2243	          (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0 Machine.State.empty
2244	            (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) π.L π.ty π.ival (initLeaves statics)) →
2245	      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π (S3.init statics)
2246	        (run Machine.State.empty (initOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok π.L π.ty π.ival statics))
2247	  | step {op : KOp} {s3 s3' : S3} {s2 : Machine.State} : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2 →

## 63. O4 — Consuming Value Transfer

**Preconditions**

1. `source` and `destination` are usable, and the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over their relevant footprints.
2. Source and destination have the **same shape of ordered subtrees**. The `i`-th child of each source part corresponds to the `i`-th child of the corresponding destination part; all nodes are matched. Structural field identity is positional, not an arbitrary matching of children.
3. **All** source leaves are `Init`, and **no** destination leaf is `Init`. The source and destination footprints are disjoint.
4. No exclusive authority is duplicated; validity of derived authorities and active projections is preserved.
5. **No in-place source leaf is pinned**, either statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (`pin`). Storage merely **owned** by the source, which is not itself moved by the transfer of that value, does not prevent this transfer.
6. Dependencies of all still-usable places following the value remain valid; non-escape constraints and `AnchorOrder` are checked in the **resulting state**, including transferred anchors of owned places that remain usable.
7. All moved held authorities, including those of owned storage, satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state; no authority may escape a local anchor on the grounds that its containing value was transferred.
8. **Local self-blocking prevention:** For each active authority held before the step by a part `r` of `source` whose holder becomes the corresponding part `corr(r)` of `destination`, that authority's footprint contains **no leaf** of `corr(r)` in the resulting state. Transfer is rejected if this local check fails; no global authority-acyclicity check is imposed.

**`ok` effect:**

- every source leaf becomes `Moved` and each corresponding destination leaf becomes `Init`;
- every authority held by source part `r` acquires as its new holder the corresponding destination part `corr(r)`, not indiscriminately the destination root;
- places owned by `r` become owned by `corr(r)`; their roots follow this owner according to `RootHeld`;
- value dependencies follow the corresponding places under validity guarantees; no authority is created or duplicated;
- destination places receive the transferred values and rights without automatically moving storage not owned by a source part.

**Other outcome:** `reject`. `transfer` to a call result is subject to these same rules.

A partially initialized structure may be transferred **field by field**, but only for fields individually eligible for transfer. This does not automatically destructure a value that owns storage **at the container level**: that storage stays with the container if the container is not transferred. Conversion between structures with permuted fields must be handled separately, not as a `transfer`.

----
# XIII. Pinning, Statics, and External Commitments

Pinning forbids certain movements or ends of lifetime. It is not a general guarantee of content immutability.

## 74. O15 — Dynamic Pinning

**Preconditions:** `place` is usable, the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over the relevant leaves, and the operation respects applicable pinning obligations.

**`ok` effect:** A dynamic pinning obligation is installed on the relevant leaves. While it is active, `transfer`, `endUse`, `free`, and `exitFrame` are rejected if they act on leaves it pins; removal of this obligation requires `unpin` under `K.ExternalDone`. Pinning does not make contents immutable. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 75. O16 — Removal of Dynamic Pinning

**Preconditions:** `place` is usable, the current frame has exercisable `Modify`, and contract `K.ExternalDone(place)` attests that all relevant external use has ended.

**`ok` effect:** The corresponding dynamic pinning obligation ends, without itself modifying values, their initialization, or their access authorities. Static obligations are not removed by this operation. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

**Associated static rule (`StaticPinnedBottom`):** Statics designated by `K.Pinned` must be places **directly** owned by the **base frame**, not merely transitively owned by a static value. This restriction ensures that they do not die when an intermediate frame exits.

----
## 10. Bytes and Initialization

This kernel considers **8-bit bytes**, whose initialized value ranges from 0 to 255.

An abstract byte is either:

- **uninitialized**;
- **initialized**, with a byte value and optional provenance information.

State is tracked **per byte** to permit partially initialized allocations. In this kernel, the provenance component can be represented by an optional allocation identity; this representation may be enriched by the access discipline. This component is **semantic** information: its existence does not imply a provenance tag physically stored in every byte.

Stored provenance comes from the **value and its representation being written**, not automatically from the provenance of the means of access used to perform the write. Rules for propagation of provenance during byte copies and reinterpretations are not yet fixed.

The initial state of a **newly created raw allocation** is wholly uninitialized. Initializing static values or constructing initialized objects are additional operations; it does not follow that all observable static storage starts uninitialized.

“All required bytes are initialized” and “these bytes represent a valid value of type T” are two different properties. Constraints on invalid representations, padding bytes, and type alignment will be specified by the corresponding specifications.

## 16. Typed Writes and Preservation of the Memory Frame

A typed write requires all applicable conditions:

1. provenance resolves to a **live** allocation;
2. the place is **spatially contained** as specified in Section 15;
3. write authority is valid;
4. the value and its representation are admissible for the type being written;
5. alignment constraints are satisfied;
6. concurrency rules are satisfied.

A valid write replaces the bytes of the written range **byte by byte** with the supplied representation and its provenance information, then marks the affected bytes initialized. It may initialize a previously uninitialized range. Provenance of the written bytes follows from the representation of the value written, not merely from the provenance of the means of access.

Bytes in other allocations and bytes outside the written range in the target allocation remain unchanged; allocation identity and the allocation counter are unaffected. The consequences of replacement for a pre-existing typed value remain to be determined.

Conditions 4, 5, and 6 are not concretely defined by this kernel; they remain explicit, parameterizable obligations. A raw write violating a safety obligation is UB; a safe interface must prevent it or produce a defined failure.

**Read-after-write and non-interference:** A valid write initializes the bytes of the written range. In the absence of an intervening write or invalidation, **every valid raw byte read of a subrange contained in the written range**, including the entire range, returns exactly the corresponding subsequence of the written contents, including abstract provenance information, subject to the other read conditions. A valid write changes neither the result of a valid read of another allocation nor that of a range disjoint from the written range. These properties concern abstract bytes and do not prejudge the reconstruction of a typed value.

## 17. Deallocation and Invalidation of Old Accesses

Successful raw deallocation requires:

1. an abstract allocation that is **live** and deallocatable;
2. **deallocation authority compatible** with that required by the allocation.

Compatibility is a semantic relation; it does not necessarily require the two allocator handles to have numerically identical identities, and it is distinct from access provenance.

Successful deallocation ends the allocation's validity. Accesses carrying its provenance can no longer read or write that old storage. An attempted double deallocation through the raw operation violates a safety obligation and constitutes UB. A safe abstraction that detects an incompatible attempt before performing a dangerous operation may produce a defined failure; this does not require a universal checked-deallocation primitive.

In the elementary memory machine, compatibility is defined between the presented authority and the recorded deallocation token. A library allocator may additionally impose constraints depending on its own state; these do not change the minimal signature of the kernel's compatibility relation.

**Validity of derived rights:** The logical invalidation of an object inside an allocation that is still live—for example, a block following an arena reset—is governed by the authorities, anchors, and end-of-use rules in Parts IV through XIV. It does not change the two elementary deallocation conditions in Section 17.

## 23. Disjointness and Splitting

Simultaneous modifications of disjoint regions are permitted when their independence and the validity of their dependencies are established. A safe abstraction may decompose a modification authority into several authorities over independent footprints, without duplicating exclusive rights or creating rights greater than those of the origin.

This capability is modeled by the kernel operation `split` (Section 61, O2). Disjointness may be structurally guaranteed, statically proved, or justified by a prior dynamic check encapsulated in a safe abstraction, including correctly justified internal unsafe operations. For `DeclaredDisjoint`, the normative condition is **leaf disjointness**; under a memory layout satisfying `LayoutWF`, it implies disjointness of the corresponding bytes. Merely asserting disjointness without justification does not authorize splitting.

The existence of the semantic `split` operation does not determine intrinsic language syntax.

2914	/-! ## Decidable sufficient conditions for `KInv` and `KAux` (§50–§54, §57) -/
2915	
2916	/-- Bounded `I1` for one pair (§50). -/
2917	def I1Pair (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
2918	  a ≠ b → OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun x => OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => x.active = true → y.active = true →
2919	    (∃ p ∈ x.footprint, p ∈ y.footprint) → a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a →
2920	      x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe) True) True
2921	
2922	/-- Decidability of `I1Pair` (§50). -/
2923	instance (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Decidable (I1Pair s a b) := by unfold I1Pair; infer_instance
2924	
2925	/-- Bounded `I1` (§50). -/
2926	def I1Check (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ a < s.A.length, ∀ b < s.A.length, I1Pair s a b
2927	
2928	/-- The origin of `y` exists, with a mode at least that of `y` and a footprint containing that of
2929	`y` (§51). -/
2930	def OriginOK (s : S3) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
2931	  OptP y.origin (fun a => OptP (s.A[a]?)
2932	    (fun x => y.mode.le x.mode ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) False) True
2933	
2934	/-- Decidability of `OriginOK` (§51). -/
2935	instance (s : S3) (y : Authority) : Decidable (OriginOK s y) := by
2936	  unfold OriginOK; infer_instance
2937	
2938	/-- Bounded `I2` (§51). -/
2939	def I2Check (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ b < s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => OriginOK s y) True
2940	
2941	/-- Bounded `I3` (§52). -/
2942	def I3Check (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q < s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x
2943	
2944	/-- Bounded `RootHeldConv` for one authority (§40, §49.7). -/
2945	def RootConvOK (s : S3) (z : Authority) : Prop :=
2946	  z.origin = none → ∀ l ∈ z.footprint, ∀ r < s.P.length, RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r →
2947	    OptP (s.P[r]?) (fun pr => z.holder = pr.owner) False
2948	
2949	/-- Decidability of `RootConvOK` (§49.7). -/
2950	instance (s : S3) (z : Authority) : Decidable (RootConvOK s z) := by
2951	  unfold RootConvOK; infer_instance
2952	
2953	/-- Bounded `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7). -/
2954	def RootHeldConvCheck (s : S3) : Prop :=
2955	  ∀ x < s.A.length, OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun z => RootConvOK s z) True
2956	
2957	/-- Decidability of the bounded clauses (§50). -/
2958	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (I1Check s) := by unfold I1Check; infer_instance
2959	/-- Decidability of the bounded clauses (§51). -/
2960	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (I2Check s) := by unfold I2Check; infer_instance
2961	/-- Decidability of the bounded clauses (§52). -/
2962	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (I3Check s) := by unfold I3Check; infer_instance
2963	/-- Decidability of the bounded clauses (§49.7). -/
2964	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (RootHeldConvCheck s) := by unfold RootHeldConvCheck; infer_instance
2965	
2966	/-- The bounded checks imply `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§49.7). -/
2967	theorem kInv_kAux_of_check {s : S3} (hw : WF3Check s) (h1 : I1Check s) (h2 : I2Check s)
2968	    (h3 : I3Check s) (ho : AnchorOrder s) (hnd : NoDanglingCheck s) (hoh : AnchorOrderHeld s)
2969	    (hc : RootHeldConvCheck s) : KInv s ∧ KAux s := by
2970	  refine ⟨kInv_of (wf3_of_check hw) ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_, i4_always s⟩, ho, noDangling_of_check hnd⟩ hoh,
2971	    ?_⟩
2972	  · intro a b x y p hab ha hb xa ya hpx hpy hba hab'
2973	    have h := h1 a (lt_of_getElem? ha) b (lt_of_getElem? hb) hab
2974	    rw [ha] at h; simp only [OptP] at h; rw [hb] at h
2975	    exact h xa ya ⟨p, hpx, hpy⟩ hba hab'
2976	  · intro b y a hb hy
2977	    have h := optP_of hb (h2 b (lt_of_getElem? hb))
2978	    unfold OriginOK at h
2979	    rw [hy] at h; simp only [OptP] at h
2980	    cases hx : s.A[a]? with
2981	    | none => rw [hx] at h; exact h.elim
2982	    | some x => rw [hx] at h; exact ⟨x, rfl, h⟩
2983	  · intro q hq x hx
2984	    exact h3 q hq.lt hq x hx
2985	  · intro x z l r hx hzo hl hr hlr
2986	    have h := optP_of hx (hc x (lt_of_getElem? hx)) hzo l hl r hr.1 hr hlr
2987	    cases hpr : s.P[r]? with
2988	    | none => rw [hpr] at h; exact h.elim
2989	    | some pr => rw [hpr] at h; exact ⟨pr, rfl, h⟩

2995	/-! ### Pinned leaves and `transfer` (§74, §63.5, §82.6) -/
2996	
2997	/-- Two static leaves `0` and `1`, `Init` (§47). -/
2998	def stP : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), true)]
2999	
3000	/-- Storage 2 allocated from provider 1 for owner 0, storage 3 for owner 2; `pin(2)` (§71, §74). -/
3001	def opsP : List KOp := [.alloc 1 0 [(none, 0)], .alloc 1 2 [(none, 0)], .pin 2]
3002	
3003	/-- Parameters of the run, fixed once from its final places (§82). -/
3004	def πP : Params Unit := piOf (kernelRun (S3.init stP) opsP).P []
3005	
3006	/-- Final states of the run (§82). -/
3007	def finP : S3 × Machine.State :=
3008	  (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW πP (sinit stP πP) opsP).getD (sinit stP πP)
3009	
3010	/-- Every step of the run passes its checks (§49, §54, §60–§75, §82). -/
3011	theorem runP_ok : (srun K0 (· = ·) obR obW πP (sinit stP πP) opsP).isSome = true := by decide
3012	
3013	/-- A pinned leaf need not stay usable across an `ok` `transfer` under the reference definitions
3014	(§74 "While it is active, `transfer` ... rejected if they act on leaves it pins"; §63.5 checks the
3015	in-place source leaves only, and `transfer` can close an ownership cycle, §63 against §49.8 and
3016	§54). From a reachable state satisfying `KInv` and `KAux` where leaf 2 is pinned
3017	and usable, `transfer(0, 3)` is accepted and leaf 2 is no longer usable. Its allocation stays live
3018	with the same address (`pinned_address_stable`: no raw operation of `transfer` deallocates), so
3019	`pinned_address_stable` does not rest on the usability of pinned leaves. -/
3020	theorem pinned_not_usable_after_transfer :
3021	    Access.Reachable K0 stP finP.1 ∧ KInv finP.1 ∧ KAux finP.1 ∧
3022	      TransferStep K0 0 3 finP.1 (.ok (transferEff finP.1 0 3)) ∧
3023	      finP.1.pin 2 = true ∧ finP.1.Usable 2 ∧ ¬ (transferEff finP.1 0 3).Usable 2 := by
3024	  have hsim := sim_of (piOf_ok _ []) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) runP_ok
3025	  exact ⟨hsim.2.2, kInv_kAux_of_check (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
3026	    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) |>.1, kInv_kAux_of_check (by decide) (by decide)
3027	    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) |>.2,
3028	    .ok (by decide), by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

5	/-!
6	# Refinement of the derived arena operations into the memory machine (spec v0, §82.7)
7	
8	Source: `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`, §82.7 with Part XIV (§76–§78), the §82
9	preamble, §82.2–§82.5 and §86.
10	
11	* Library operations (`LOp`) and their `ok` steps (`LOpStep`): the kernel operations O1–O16 and
12	  the derived arena operations O17–O19 of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena`.
13	* The kernel steps realizing a library step (`kexp`, `kexp_path`, Part XIV): none for `newArena`,
14	  `split` then `store` for `issue`, `derive` then `release` for `reset`. The raw operations of a
15	  library step (`lopsOf`) are the raw operations of these kernel steps (`ktrace`).
16	* Per derived operation: realization, reads, writes and lifetimes (`arena_newArena`,
17	  `arena_issue`, `arena_reset`, `reset_split`, `issue_pointer_sound`).
18	* Library runs translated into the memory machine with parameters fixed once per run
19	  (`LSimRun`): every such run is a kernel simulation run (`LSimRun.simRun`); `lsimulation`.
20	* §82.7: the machine trace of a library run is the trace of its kernel steps, and no kernel step
21	  after a legal `reset` uses an authority that the `reset` invalidated (`arena_realized`).
22	
23	The sequential fragment only (§18, §29): no theorem here says anything about concurrency.
24	-/

26	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.RefinementArena
27	
28	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement Ern.MemoryModel.Arena
29	
30	/-! ## Library operations and their kernel steps (Part XIV) -/
31	
32	/-- An operation of a library run (Part XIV): a kernel operation O1–O16 of non-administrative
33	code (§60–§75), or one of the derived arena operations O17–O19 (§76–§78). -/
34	inductive LOp where
35	  /-- A kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75). -/
36	  | kernel (op : KOp)
37	  /-- O17 `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76); `others` are the other registries of live
38	  administrations consulted by the guard (§56, §76.4). -/
39	  | newArena (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat)
40	  /-- O18 `issue(arena, region, destination)` of entry `i` (§77). -/
41	  | issue (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
42	  /-- O19 `reset(arena)` of entry `i` (§78). -/
43	  | reset (i : Nat)
44	
45	/-- The `ok` step of a library operation (Part XIV, §58): a kernel step leaves the registry
46	unchanged (§46); the arena operations are the derived operations (`NewArenaStep`, `IssueD`,
47	`ResetD`). -/
48	def LOpStep (k : K) : LOp → LState → LState → Prop
49	  | .kernel op, L, L' => OpStep k op L.kern L'.kern ∧ L'.arenas = L.arenas
50	  | .newArena others st i, L, L' => NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L')
51	  | .issue i region dst, L, L' => IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L')
52	  | .reset i, L, L' => ResetD i L (.ok L')
53	
54	/-- A labelled library step is a library step (Part XIV, §76–§78). -/
55	theorem LOpStep.lstep {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} (h : LOpStep k lop L L') :
56	    LStep k L L' := by
57	  cases lop with
58	  | kernel op =>
59	    have h' : OpStep k op L.kern L'.kern ∧ L'.arenas = L.arenas := h
60	    obtain ⟨s', ar⟩ := L'
61	    obtain ⟨hs, ha⟩ := h'
62	    dsimp only at hs ha
63	    subst ha
64	    exact .kernel hs.kstep
65	  | newArena => exact .newArena h
66	  | issue => exact .issue h
67	  | reset => exact .reset h
68	
69	/-- Every kernel step is the `ok` step of a kernel operation (§57, §58); the representations
70	carried by `write` and `writeShared` are not read by the kernel (§10 ¶4). -/
71	theorem kstep_labelled {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : ∃ op, OpStep k op s s' := by
72	  cases h with
73	  | derive h => exact ⟨.derive _ _ _, h⟩
74	  | split h => exact ⟨.split _ _, h⟩
75	  | release h => exact ⟨.release _, h⟩
76	  | transfer h => exact ⟨.transfer _ _, h⟩
77	  | depend h => exact ⟨.depend _ _, h⟩
78	  | enter h => exact ⟨.enter _ _, h⟩
79	  | exit h => exact ⟨.exit, h⟩
80	  | read h => exact ⟨.read _ _, h⟩
81	  | write h => exact ⟨.write _ _ fun _ _ => (0, none), h⟩
82	  | writeShared h => exact ⟨.writeShared _ _ fun _ _ => (0, none), h⟩
83	  | pin h => exact ⟨.pin _, h⟩
84	  | unpin h => exact ⟨.unpin _, h⟩
85	  | endUse h => exact ⟨.endUse _, h⟩
86	  | free h => exact ⟨.free _ _, h⟩
87	  | alloc h => exact ⟨.alloc _ _ _, h⟩
88	  | store h => exact ⟨.store _ _, h⟩
89	
90	/-- Every library step is the `ok` step of a library operation (Part XIV, §76–§78): labelled
91	steps cover all library runs. -/
92	theorem LStep.labelled {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') : ∃ lop, LOpStep k lop L L' := by
93	  cases h with
94	  | kernel hk =>
95	    obtain ⟨op, h⟩ := kstep_labelled hk
96	    exact ⟨.kernel op, h, rfl⟩
97	  | newArena hs => exact ⟨.newArena _ _ _, hs⟩
98	  | issue hs => exact ⟨.issue _ _ _, hs⟩
99	  | reset hs => exact ⟨.reset _, hs⟩
100	
101	/-- The kernel steps realizing a library operation from `L`, each with the kernel state it starts
102	from (Part XIV, §82.7): a kernel operation is its own step; `newArena` has none (§76: it registers
103	an administration without modifying the kernel); `issue` is `split` of `internal` on the region,
104	then `store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into the destination (§77); `reset` is
105	`derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the storage, then `release` of the derived authority `|A|`
106	(§78). Without an entry, there is no step. -/
107	def kexp : LOp → LState → List (KOp × S3)
108	  | .kernel op, L => [(op, L.kern)]
109	  | .newArena .., _ => []
110	  | .issue i region dst, L => match L.arenas[i]? with
111	    | some E => [(.split E.internal [region], L.kern),
112	        (.store L.kern.A.length dst, splitEff L.kern E.internal [region])]
113	    | none => []
114	  | .reset i, L => match L.arenas[i]? with
115	    | some E => [(.derive E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify, L.kern),
116	        (.release L.kern.A.length,
117	          deriveEff L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify)]
118	    | none => []
119	
120	/-- A sequence of `ok` kernel steps (§57, §58), each listed with the state it starts from. -/
121	inductive KPath (k : K) : S3 → List (KOp × S3) → S3 → Prop where
122	  | nil (s : S3) : KPath k s [] s
123	  | cons {op : KOp} {s s₁ s' : S3} {t : List (KOp × S3)} :
124	      OpStep k op s s₁ → KPath k s₁ t s' → KPath k s ((op, s) :: t) s'
125	
126	/-- §82.7 (realization by O1–O16; Part XIV): every `ok` library step is the sequence of its
127	kernel steps `kexp`, from the kernel state before it to the kernel state after it. -/
128	theorem kexp_path {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} (h : LOpStep k lop L L') :
129	    KPath k L.kern (kexp lop L) L'.kern := by
130	  cases lop with
131	  | kernel op => exact .cons h.1 (.nil _)
132	  | newArena others st i =>
133	    rw [newArena_kernel (show NewArenaStep others st i L (.ok L') from h)]
134	    exact .nil _
135	  | issue i region dst =>
136	    have h' : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') := h
137	    cases h' with
138	    | ok hE _ _ hsp hst =>
139	      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp
140	      simp only [kexp, hE]
141	      exact .cons hsp (.cons hst (.nil _))
142	  | reset i =>
143	    have h' : ResetD i L (.ok L') := h
144	    cases h' with
145	    | ok hE hd hrl _ =>
146	      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd
147	      simp only [kexp, hE]
148	      exact .cons hd (.cons hrl (.nil _))
149	
150	/-- The steps of a kernel sequence keep the authorities of its first state (§42, §58), and each
151	is an `ok` step from the state listed with it. -/
152	theorem KPath.mem {k : K} {s s' : S3} {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s t s') :
153	    ∀ q ∈ t, AKeep s q.2 ∧ ∃ s₁, OpStep k q.1 q.2 s₁ := by
154	  induction hp with
155	  | nil => intro q hq; cases hq
156	  | cons h _ ih =>
157	    intro q hq
158	    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hq with rfl | hq
159	    · exact ⟨akeep_of_eq rfl, _, h⟩
160	    · obtain ⟨hk, hs⟩ := ih q hq
161	      exact ⟨(kstep_akeep h.kstep).trans hk, hs⟩
162	
163	/-- The kernel steps of a library step start from states satisfying `WF3` and `NoDangling` when
164	the library state does (§49, §54): the states after `split` and after `derive` keep both
165	(§60, §61). -/
166	theorem kexp_inv {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L' : LState} (h : LOpStep k lop L L') (hw : WF3 L.kern)
167	    (hnd : NoDangling L.kern) : ∀ q ∈ kexp lop L, WF3 q.2 ∧ NoDangling q.2 := by
168	  cases lop with
169	  | kernel op =>
170	    intro q hq
171	    rw [kexp, List.mem_singleton] at hq
172	    subst hq
173	    exact ⟨hw, hnd⟩
174	  | newArena => intro q hq; cases hq
175	  | issue i region dst =>
176	    have h' : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L') := h
177	    cases h' with
178	    | ok hE _ _ hsp _ =>
179	      have e := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).2
180	      subst e
181	      intro q hq
182	      simp only [kexp, hE, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hq
183	      rcases hq with rfl | rfl
184	      · exact ⟨hw, hnd⟩
185	      · exact ⟨split_preserves_wf3 hw hsp, split_preserves_noDangling hnd hsp⟩
186	  | reset i =>
187	    have h' : ResetD i L (.ok L') := h
188	    cases h' with
189	    | ok hE hd _ _ =>
190	      have e := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hd).2
191	      subst e
192	      intro q hq
193	      simp only [kexp, hE, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hq
194	      rcases hq with rfl | rfl
195	      · exact ⟨hw, hnd⟩
196	      · exact ⟨derive_preserves_wf3 hw hd, derive_preserves_noDangling hnd hd⟩
197	
198	/-! ## Raw operations of library steps (§82 preamble, §82.7) -/
199	
200	section Trace
201	
202	variable {Ty : Type}
203	
204	/-- The raw operations realizing a sequence of kernel steps (§82 preamble, §20.3): the raw
205	operations `opsOf` of each step, in the memory state reached by the previous ones. -/
206	def ktrace (π : Params Ty) : List (KOp × S3) → Machine.State → List (Machine.Op Ty)
207	  | [], _ => []
208	  | (op, s3) :: t, s2 => opsOf π op s3 s2 ++ ktrace π t (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2))
209	
210	/-- The raw operations realizing a library step (§82.7): those of its kernel steps. -/
211	def lopsOf (π : Params Ty) (lop : LOp) (L : LState) (s2 : Machine.State) : List (Machine.Op Ty) :=
212	  ktrace π (kexp lop L) s2
213	
214	/-- The raw operations of composed kernel sequences are composed (§20.3 ¶3). -/
215	theorem ktrace_append (π : Params Ty) (t t' : List (KOp × S3)) (s2 : Machine.State) :
216	    ktrace π (t ++ t') s2 = ktrace π t s2 ++ ktrace π t' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
217	  induction t generalizing s2 with
218	  | nil => rfl
219	  | cons p t ih =>
220	    obtain ⟨op, s3⟩ := p
221	    simp only [List.cons_append, ktrace, ih, run_append, List.append_assoc]
222	
223	/-- The obligations of each kernel step of a sequence (§20.3, §82; `StepObl`), in the memory
224	state reached by the previous ones. -/
225	def KObl (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
226	    (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) (π : Params Ty) : List (KOp × S3) → Machine.State → Prop
227	  | [], _ => True
228	  | (op, s3) :: t, s2 =>
229	    StepObl k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2 ∧ KObl k C ObR ObW π t (run s2 (opsOf π op s3 s2))
230	
231	/-- The memory state realizing the initial state (§47, §82 preamble; `repr_init`): the creations
232	of the static allocations, then the writes of the static leaves declared `Init`. -/
233	def minit (π : Params Ty) (statics : Statics) : Machine.State :=
234	  run Machine.State.empty (initOps π.pl π.geom π.rtok π.L π.ty π.ival statics)
235	
236	end Trace
237	
238	/-- Realization of a kernel sequence (§82 preamble, R6 of each step): from states satisfying
239	`WF3` and `NoDangling`, under the obligations of each step, the raw operations of the sequence
240	form an execution of `ok` raw steps and `Repr` holds after it. -/
241	theorem r6_path {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
242	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {π : Params Ty} (hπ : ParamsOK C π) {s3 s3' : S3}
243	    {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s3 t s3') :
244	    ∀ {s2 : Machine.State}, (∀ q ∈ t, WF3 q.2 ∧ NoDangling q.2) → KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2 →
245	      Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3 s2 →
246	      Machine.Exec C ObR ObW (ktrace π t s2) s2 (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) ∧
247	        Refinement.Repr π.L π.rtok s3' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
248	  induction hp with
249	  | nil => intro s2 _ _ hR; exact ⟨.nil _, hR⟩
250	  | cons h _ ih =>
251	    intro s2 hinv hob hR
252	    obtain ⟨hw, hnd⟩ := hinv _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)
253	    obtain ⟨hob₁, hob₂⟩ := hob
254	    obtain ⟨hex, hR₁⟩ := r6 hπ hR hw hnd h hob₁
255	    obtain ⟨hex', hR'⟩ := ih (fun q hq => hinv q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq)) hob₂ hR₁
256	    simp only [ktrace]
257	    rw [run_append]
258	    exact ⟨exec_append hex hex', hR'⟩
