341	    (hs : IssueD k i region dst L (.ok L'))
342	    (hpd : PtrDecided π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)
343	    (hob : OblAlong ObR ObW s2
344	      (storeOps π.pe s2 π.L π.ty (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length dst)) :
345	    (∃ ad, ptrAddr s2 π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length = some ad ∧

347	        (π.pe.enc ad (some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region])

354	  rw [issue_ops hE]
355	  cases hs with
356	  | @ok E' s₁ s₂ hE' _ _ hsp hst =>
357	  rw [hE] at hE'
358	  cases hE'
359	  have e₁ := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).2
360	  subst e₁
361	  have hpre := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hsp).1
362	  have hw₁ := split_preserves_wf3 hw hsp
363	  obtain ⟨hex, hR₂⟩ := r6_store (C := C) (r6_split hR hsp) hw₁ hst hpd hob
364	  have e₂ := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 hst).2
365	  subst e₂
366	  obtain ⟨ad, had⟩ := ptrAddr_isSome (s2 := s2) hpd
367	  refine ⟨⟨ad, had, by simp only [storeOps, had, writeOps, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]⟩, hex,
368	    hR₂, ?_⟩
369	  unfold LiveCover
370	  intro hlc j y hy ya l hl
371	  have hwf := hR.adm.wf
372	  have hn := storeOps_noDealloc π.pe s2 π.L π.ty (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region])
373	    L.kern.A.length dst
374	  dsimp only at hy ⊢
375	  rw [← issueKEff_eq] at hy ⊢
376	  have hA : (issueKEff L.kern E region dst).A =
377	      L.kern.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩] := rfl
378	  rw [hA] at hy
379	  show l < L.kern.P.length ∧ isLeaf L.kern.P l ∧ _
380	  by_cases hj : j < L.kern.A.length
381	  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hj] at hy
382	    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hlc j y hy ya l hl
383	    exact ⟨h1, h2, liveWithin_run hwf hn h3⟩
384	  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at hy
385	    have hly : l ∈ region := by
386	      cases h0 : j - L.kern.A.length with
387	      | zero =>
388	        rw [h0] at hy
389	        simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hy
390	        rw [← hy] at hl
391	        exact hl
392	      | succ n => rw [h0] at hy; simp at hy
393	    obtain ⟨hin, -⟩ := hpre.within region (List.mem_singleton_self _) l hly
394	    obtain ⟨yi, hyi, yia⟩ := hpre.active
395	    have hl' : l ∈ yi.footprint := by simpa [S3.afp, hyi] using hin
396	    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hlc _ yi hyi yia l hl'

411	    (henc : PtrEncAt π.pe ad
412	      (some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length))) :

415	      some (anchorAlloc π.L (splitEff L.kern E.internal [region]) L.kern.A.length)) ∧

418	      AllocP s2 (π.L l).alloc fun al => al.live = true ∧ (π.L l).off + (π.L l).len ≤ al.size := by

497	the kernel invariant, §57, as in `SimRun`), under the obligations of its kernel steps, followed by

501	    LState → Machine.State → Prop where
502	  | init : StaticsOK statics →
503	      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →
504	      OblAlong ObR ObW (run Machine.State.empty (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0
505	        Machine.State.empty (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) (writeOps (run Machine.State.empty
506	          (allocOps (Ty := Ty) π.pl π.geom π.rtok 0 Machine.State.empty
507	            (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))))) π.L π.ty π.ival (initLeaves statics)) →

514	satisfying `WF3` and `NoDangling`, under their obligations (§82 preamble). -/

516	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {s3 s3' : S3}
517	    {t : List (KOp × S3)} (hp : KPath k s3 t s3') :
518	    ∀ {s2 : Machine.State}, SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3 s2 →
519	      (∀ q ∈ t, WF3 q.2 ∧ NoDangling q.2) → KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2 →
520	      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π s3' (run s2 (ktrace π t s2)) := by
521	  induction hp with
522	  | nil => intro s2 h _ _; exact h
523	  | cons h _ ih =>
524	    intro s2 hs hinv hob
525	    obtain ⟨hw, hnd⟩ := hinv _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)
526	    obtain ⟨hob₁, hob₂⟩ := hob
527	    have := ih (SimRun.step hs hw hnd h hob₁) (fun q hq => hinv q (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hq))
528	      hob₂
529	    simp only [ktrace]
530	    rw [run_append]
531	    exact this

573	/-- Labelled library runs (Part XIV, §82.7): each library operation listed with the library
574	state it starts from. -/
575	inductive LPath (k : K) : LState → List (LOp × LState) → LState → Prop where
576	  | nil (L : LState) : LPath k L [] L
577	  | cons {lop : LOp} {L L₁ L' : LState} {t : List (LOp × LState)} :
578	      LOpStep k lop L L₁ → LPath k L₁ t L' → LPath k L ((lop, L) :: t) L'
579	
580	/-- The kernel steps of a labelled library run, in order (Part XIV, §82.7). -/
581	def ltrace : List (LOp × LState) → List (KOp × S3)
582	  | [] => []
583	  | (lop, L) :: t => kexp lop L ++ ltrace t
584	
585	/-- Kernel steps of composed labelled runs (Part XIV, §82.7). -/
586	theorem ltrace_append (t t' : List (LOp × LState)) : ltrace (t ++ t') = ltrace t ++ ltrace t' := by
587	  induction t with
588	  | nil => rfl
589	  | cons p t ih =>
590	    obtain ⟨lop, L⟩ := p
591	    simp only [List.cons_append, ltrace, ih, List.append_assoc]
592	
593	/-- Extension of a labelled library run by one step (Part XIV, §82.7). -/
594	theorem LPath.snoc {k : K} {L₀ L L' : LState} {t : List (LOp × LState)} {lop : LOp}
595	    (hp : LPath k L₀ t L) (hs : LOpStep k lop L L') : LPath k L₀ (t ++ [(lop, L)]) L' := by
596	  induction hp with
597	  | nil => exact .cons hs (.nil _)
598	  | cons h _ ih => exact .cons h (ih hs)
599	
600	/-- The continuation of a labelled library run after one of its steps (Part XIV, §82.7). -/
601	theorem LPath.split {k : K} {lop : LOp} {L L₂ : LState} {t₂ : List (LOp × LState)} :
602	    ∀ (t₁ : List (LOp × LState)) {L₀ : LState}, LPath k L₀ (t₁ ++ (lop, L) :: t₂) L₂ →
603	      ∃ L₁, LOpStep k lop L L₁ ∧ LPath k L₁ t₂ L₂
604	  | [], _, h => by
605	    cases h with
606	    | cons hs hp => exact ⟨_, hs, hp⟩
607	  | (_, _) :: t₁, _, h => by
608	    cases h with
609	    | cons _ hp => exact LPath.split t₁ hp
610	
611	/-- The machine trace of a translated library run is the trace of its kernel steps (§82.7): the
612	run is a labelled library run from the initial library state, and its memory state is reached
613	from the initial memory state by the raw operations of its kernel steps, in order. -/
614	theorem LSimRun.trace {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
615	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
616	    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) :
617	    ∃ t, LPath k (LState.init statics) t L ∧
618	      s2 = run (minit π statics) (ktrace π (ltrace t) (minit π statics)) := by
619	  induction h with
620	  | init => exact ⟨[], .nil _, rfl⟩
621	  | step _ _ _ hs _ ih =>
622	    obtain ⟨t, hp, rfl⟩ := ih
623	    refine ⟨_, hp.snoc hs, ?_⟩
624	    rw [ltrace_append, ktrace_append, run_append]
625	    simp only [ltrace, List.append_nil]
626	    rfl
627	
628	/-- The authority that a kernel step uses as a means of access (§82.7): the authority through
629	which `read`, `write` and `writeShared` access leaves (§66.2, §67.1, §68.2), the authority whose
630	reference `store` writes (§65, §82.3), and the source from which `derive` and `split` create new
631	means of access (§60.1, §61.1). The other operations use none. -/
632	def usedAuth : KOp → Option Nat
633	  | .read a _ => some a
634	  | .write a _ _ => some a
635	  | .writeShared a _ _ => some a
636	  | .store a _ => some a
637	  | .derive src _ _ => some src
638	  | .split src _ => some src
639	  | _ => none
640	
641	/-- An authority exercisable at some mode is active (§43). -/
642	theorem active_of_exercisable {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : s.ExercisableAt a m) :
643	    s.Active a := by
644	  cases h with
645	  | base hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩
646	  | held hy ha => exact ⟨_, hy, ha⟩
647	
648	/-- A kernel step uses only an active authority (§60.1, §61.1, §65.1, §66.2, §67.1, §68.2). -/
649	theorem usedAuth_active {k : K} {op : KOp} {s s' : S3} {j : Nat} (h : OpStep k op s s')
650	    (hv : usedAuth op = some j) : s.Active j := by
651	  cases op with
652	  | read a ls =>
653	    obtain rfl : a = j := Option.some.inj hv
654	    exact active_of_exercisable (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.exercisable
655	  | write a ls w =>
656	    obtain rfl : a = j := Option.some.inj hv
657	    exact active_of_exercisable (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.exercisable
658	  | writeShared a ls w =>
659	    obtain rfl : a = j := Option.some.inj hv
660	    exact active_of_exercisable (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.exercisable
661	  | store a p =>
662	    obtain rfl : a = j := Option.some.inj hv
663	    have hd := (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.derivedHeld
664	    unfold OptP at hd
665	    split at hd
666	    · exact ⟨_, ‹_›, hd.1⟩
667	    · exact hd.elim
668	  | derive src r m =>
669	    obtain rfl : src = j := Option.some.inj hv
670	    exact (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.active
671	  | split src rs =>
672	    obtain rfl : src = j := Option.some.inj hv
673	    exact (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.active
674	  | transfer => cases hv
675	  | release => cases hv
676	  | depend => cases hv
677	  | enter => cases hv
678	  | exit => cases hv
679	  | pin => cases hv
680	  | unpin => cases hv
681	  | endUse => cases hv
682	  | free => cases hv
683	  | alloc => cases hv
684	
685	/-- Along a labelled library run whose start keeps the authorities of `s₀`, no kernel step uses
686	an authority of `s₀` that is inactive in `s₀` (§42, §58: authorities are never reactivated). -/
687	theorem lpath_unused {k : K} {s₀ : S3} {j : Nat} (hj : j < s₀.A.length) (hd : ¬ s₀.Active j)
688	    {L L₂ : LState} {t : List (LOp × LState)} (hp : LPath k L t L₂) :
689	    AKeep s₀ L.kern → ∀ q ∈ ltrace t, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some j := by
690	  induction hp with
691	  | nil => intro _ q hq; cases hq
692	  | cons hs _ ih =>
693	    intro hk q hq hv
694	    simp only [ltrace, List.mem_append] at hq
695	    rcases hq with hq | hq
696	    · obtain ⟨hk', s₁, hst⟩ := (kexp_path hs).mem q hq
697	      exact hd ((hk.trans hk').active_back (usedAuth_active hst hv) hj)
698	    · exact ih (hk.trans (lstep_akeep hs.lstep)) q hq hv
699	
700	/-- No access after invalidation (§82.7, §78, §86): after a legal `reset` of entry `i`, along
701	every continuation of the library run, no kernel step reads, writes or writes in shared mode
702	through, stores, or derives or splits from an authority derived from `internal` that covered a
703	leaf of the administered storage; so none of the raw operations of the continuation realizes an
704	access through it. -/
705	theorem reset_no_access {k : K} {L L₁ L₂ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
706	    {t : List (LOp × LState)} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁))
707	    (hp : LPath k L₁ t L₂) {j : Nat} (hj : E.internal ∈ L.kern.ancs j)
708	    (hc : ∃ l ∈ L.kern.afp j, l ∈ footprint L.kern.P E.storage) :
709	    ∀ q ∈ ltrace t, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some j := by
710	  have hjL : j < L.kern.A.length := by
711	    obtain ⟨l, hl, -⟩ := hc
712	    cases hlj : L.kern.A[j]? with
713	    | none => simp [S3.afp, hlj] at hl
714	    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hlj
715	  exact lpath_unused ((lstep_akeep (k := k) (.reset hr)).lt hjL) (reset_ends_covering hE hr hj hc)
716	    hp (akeep_of_eq rfl)
717	
718	/-- No access through an issued block after a legal reset of its arena (§82.7, §78, §86): for a
719	live entry satisfying `EntryInv`, after a legal `reset`, along every continuation of the library
720	run, no kernel step uses a block issued before the reset on a nonempty region. -/
721	theorem reset_no_access_issued {k : K} {L L₁ L₂ : LState} {i : Nat} {E : ArenaEntry}
722	    {t : List (LOp × LState)} (hE : L.arenas[i]? = some E) (hinv : EntryInv L.kern E)
723	    (hr : ResetD i L (.ok L₁)) (hp : LPath k L₁ t L₂) :
724	    ∀ e ∈ E.issued, e.1 ≠ [] → ∀ q ∈ ltrace t, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some e.2 := by
725	  intro e he hne
726	  obtain ⟨y, hy, ho, hlt, hf, -⟩ := hinv.2 e he
727	  have hj : E.internal ∈ L.kern.ancs e.2 := by
728	    unfold S3.ancs
729	    rw [chain_cons (by simp [S3.org, hy, ho]) hlt]
730	    exact List.mem_cons_self ..
731	  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := List.exists_mem_of_ne_nil _ hne
732	  exact reset_no_access hE hr hp hj ⟨l, by simp [S3.afp, hy, hf, hl], hinv.1.issuedIn e he l hl⟩
733	
734	/-- §82.7 for translated library runs: the derived operations and their metadata, outside `S₃`,
735	are realized by O1–O16 without reintroducing access after invalidation. The run is a labelled
736	library run from the initial library state; its memory state is reached from the initial memory
737	state by the raw operations of its kernel steps (the machine trace of the run is the trace of its
738	kernel steps); and after every legal `reset` in the run, no kernel step of the continuation uses
739	an authority derived from `internal` that covered a leaf of the administered storage, so no raw
740	operation of the continuation is an access through it. -/
741	theorem arena_realized {Ty : Type} {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty}
742	    {ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty} {statics : Statics} {π : Params Ty} {L : LState}
743	    {s2 : Machine.State} (h : LSimRun k C ObR ObW statics π L s2) :
744	    ∃ t, LPath k (LState.init statics) t L ∧
745	      s2 = run (minit π statics) (ktrace π (ltrace t) (minit π statics)) ∧
746	      ∀ t₁ t₂ L₀ i E, t = t₁ ++ (.reset i, L₀) :: t₂ → L₀.arenas[i]? = some E →
747	        ∀ j, E.internal ∈ L₀.kern.ancs j →
748	          (∃ l ∈ L₀.kern.afp j, l ∈ footprint L₀.kern.P E.storage) →
749	          ∀ q ∈ ltrace t₂, usedAuth q.1 ≠ some j := by
750	  obtain ⟨t, hp, hs⟩ := h.trace
751	  refine ⟨t, hp, hs, ?_⟩
752	  rintro t₁ t₂ L₀ i E rfl hE j hj hc
753	  obtain ⟨L₁, hr, hp₂⟩ := LPath.split t₁ hp
754	  exact reset_no_access hE hr hp₂ hj hc
755	
756	/-! ## A concrete library run (non-vacuity; §82.7, Part XIV) -/
757	
758	section Dec
759	
760	variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
761	  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
762	  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]
763	  {Ty : Type} (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel C] (ObR : Machine.ReadOblSpec Ty)
764	  (ObW : Machine.WriteOblSpec Ty) [∀ s o, Decidable (Obl ObR ObW s o)] (π : Params Ty)
765	
766	/-- Decidability of the obligations of a kernel sequence (§20.3, §82). -/
767	instance kOblDec : (t : List (KOp × S3)) → (s2 : Machine.State) →
768	    Decidable (KObl k C ObR ObW π t s2)
769	  | [], _ => isTrue trivial
770	  | (op, s3) :: t, s2 =>
771	    @instDecidableAnd _ _ (stepOblDec k C ObR ObW π op s3 s2) (kOblDec t _)
772	
773	end Dec
774	
775	namespace Runs
776	
777	open Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Examples Ern.MemoryModel.Refinement.Runs
778	
779	/-- Memory state after the library operations `t`, each listed with the library state it starts
780	from, from the memory state `m` (§82.7). -/
781	def lrunM {Ty : Type} (π : Params Ty) : List (LOp × LState) → Machine.State → Machine.State
782	  | [], m => m
783	  | (lop, L) :: t, m => lrunM π t (run m (lopsOf π lop L m))
784	
785	/-- The memory state after library operations is reached by the raw operations of their kernel
786	steps (§82.7). -/
787	theorem lrunM_eq {Ty : Type} (π : Params Ty) :
788	    ∀ (t : List (LOp × LState)) (m : Machine.State), lrunM π t m = run m (ktrace π (ltrace t) m)
789	  | [], _ => rfl
790	  | (lop, L) :: t, m => by
791	    rw [lrunM, lrunM_eq π t, ltrace, ktrace_append, run_append]
792	    rfl
793	
794	/-- A library run through every derived arena operation (Part XIV, §76–§78; the states of
795	`Arena.Witness`): `derive(1, [1], Modify)` and `store(3, 0)` prepare `internal` 3 held by the arena
796	value 0; `newArena(1, 3)`; `issue(0, [1], 2)` (block 4 stored into 2); `write(4, [1])`;
797	`endUse(2)`; `reset(0)`; `issue(0, [1], 2)` again (block 6). -/
798	def tA : List (LOp × LState) :=
799	  [(.kernel (.derive 1 [1] .modify), Witness.w0), (.kernel (.store 3 0), Witness.w1),
800	   (.newArena [] 1 3, Witness.w2), (.issue 0 [1] 2, Witness.w3),
801	   (.kernel (.write 4 [1] wv), Witness.r4), (.kernel (.endUse 2), Witness.r5),
802	   (.reset 0, Witness.r6), (.issue 0 [1] 2, Witness.r7)]
803	
804	/-- Parameters of the run, fixed once (§82): the test layout of the three static places. -/
805	def πA : Params Unit := piOf (S3.init st).P []
806	
807	/-- Final memory state of the run (§82.7). -/
808	def finA : Machine.State := lrunM πA tA (minit πA st)
809	
810	/-- The run is a translated library run (§82.7, non-vacuity of `LSimRun`): each step starts from
811	a state satisfying `WF3` and `NoDangling`, is an `ok` library step, and its kernel steps satisfy
812	their obligations under the fixed parameters. -/
813	theorem runA_lsim : LSimRun K0 (· = ·) obR obW st πA Witness.r8 finA := by
814	  have h0 : LSimRun K0 (· = ·) obR obW st πA Witness.w0 (minit πA st) :=
815	    .init (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
816	  have h1 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.derive 1 [1] .modify)) (L' := Witness.w1) h0
817	    (wf3_of_check (by decide)) (noDangling_of_check (by decide)) ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩
818	    (by decide)
819	  have h2 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.store 3 0)) (L' := Witness.w2) h1
820	    (wf3_of_check (by decide)) (noDangling_of_check (by decide)) ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩
821	    (by decide)
822	  have h3 := LSimRun.step (lop := .newArena [] 1 3) (L' := Witness.w3) h2
823	    (wf3_of_check (by decide)) (noDangling_of_check (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)) (by decide)
824	  have h4 := LSimRun.step (lop := .issue 0 [1] 2) (L' := Witness.r4) h3
825	    (wf3_of_check (by decide)) (noDangling_of_check (by decide))
826	    (IssueD.ok (E := Witness.wE) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
827	      (.ok (by decide))) (by decide)
828	  have h5 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.write 4 [1] wv)) (L' := Witness.r5) h4
829	    (wf3_of_check (by decide)) (noDangling_of_check (by decide)) ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩
830	    (by decide)
831	  have h6 := LSimRun.step (lop := .kernel (.endUse 2)) (L' := Witness.r6) h5
832	    (wf3_of_check (by decide)) (noDangling_of_check (by decide)) ⟨.ok (by decide), rfl⟩
833	    (by decide)
834	  have h7 := LSimRun.step (lop := .reset 0) (L' := Witness.r7) h6
835	    (wf3_of_check (by decide)) (noDangling_of_check (by decide))
836	    (ResetD.ok (E := Witness.rE) (by decide) (.ok (by decide)) (.ok (by decide)) (by decide))
837	    (by decide)
838	  exact LSimRun.step (lop := .issue 0 [1] 2) (L' := Witness.r8) h7
839	    (wf3_of_check (by decide)) (noDangling_of_check (by decide))
840	    (IssueD.ok (E := Witness.rE') (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (.ok (by decide))
841	      (.ok (by decide))) (by decide)
842	
843	/-- Non-vacuity of the library simulation (§82.7, §82.3): the run is translated into an execution
844	of `ok` raw steps from the empty state, `Repr` holds at its end, the final library state is
845	library-reachable, and the machine trace is the trace of the kernel steps. The reference written
846	into the arena value 0 and the one written into the destination 2 by the second issue decode to
847	the address of the storage leaf 1, which is nonzero and whose allocation is live. The range of
848	leaf 1 still holds the bytes written through block 4 before the `reset`: the reissued block 6
849	designates the former value in the memory machine too (no rule of §77 or §78 changes these bytes;
850	see `Arena.Witness.reissue_reads_former_value` for §86). -/
851	theorem runA_sim :
852	    ((∃ ops, Machine.Exec (· = ·) obR obW ops Machine.State.empty finA) ∧
853	      Refinement.Repr πA.L πA.rtok Witness.r8.kern finA ∧ LReach K0 st Witness.r8) ∧
854	    finA = run (minit πA st) (ktrace πA (ltrace tA) (minit πA st)) ∧
855	    decodedAt πA finA 0 = leafAddr finA πA.L 1 ∧ decodedAt πA finA 2 = leafAddr finA πA.L 1 ∧
856	    leafAddr finA πA.L 1 ≠ 0 ∧ (finA.allocs (πA.L 1).alloc).map (·.live) = some true ∧
857	    ∀ n < 8, bytesOf finA πA.L 1 n = wv 1 n :=
858	  ⟨lsimulation (piOf_ok _ []) runA_lsim, lrunM_eq _ _ _, by decide, by decide, by decide,
859	    by decide, by decide⟩
860	
861	end Runs

/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (§72) -/

/-- Places after `enterFrame` (§72, `ok` effect): the locals appended, owned by the new frame. -/
def enterP (s : S3) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place := shapeP s.P (.frame s.nF) ls.toShape

/-- Effect of `enterFrame(params, locals)` (§72, `ok` effect): a new frame `nF` is pushed; the
parameters are now held by it; locals are appended (uninitialized, no anchor, alive, unpinned)
with one active root `Modify` authority per root local, held by the new frame. -/
def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
      (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
        ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i),
          shapeOwner ls.toShape (.frame s.nF) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q }

/-- Origin protection on entry for parameter `p` in state `s'` (§72.3): if `p` is a `Modify`
authority with direct origin `o`, `o` is exercisable in no mode. -/
def ParamOriginHidden (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s'.A[p]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify →
    OptP y.origin (fun o => ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .observe ∧ ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .modify) True) True

/-- Decidability of `ParamOriginHidden` (§72.3). -/
instance (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (ParamOriginHidden s' p) := by
  unfold ParamOriginHidden; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). The modes/footprints/parameter-passing part of §72.2 is
not represented. -/
structure EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- §72.1: the calling frame, the current frame, is live. -/
  callerLive : s.F ≠ []
  /-- §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
    y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape (each parent is an earlier local). -/
  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- §72.3: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state. -/
  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p
  /-- §72.4: `AnchorOrderHeld` over the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). -/
instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.F ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
      y.holder = .frame s.top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧

/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀` (§73.4): active and held by a surviving frame
or by a usable place whose terminal owner survives. -/
def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False

/-- First surviving authority of a list (§73.4). -/
def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)

/-- Authority `a` after the exit (§73, `ok` effect): released unless it survives; a surviving
derived authority is reanchored to the first surviving active origin of its chain. -/
def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
  if Survives s F₀ a then
    match y.origin with

  else { y with active := false }

not survive are released; surviving derived authorities and the anchors of `D` are reanchored to
the first surviving authority of their chains. -/

anchor anywhere. -/

  nF := 2

/-! ## O14 `alloc` (§71) -/

/-- Static preconditions of `alloc provider owner shape` (§71, items 1–3). -/
structure AllocStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
  /-- §71.1: the shape is nonempty. -/
  nonempty : ls ≠ []
  /-- §71.1: the shape is represented like the locals of `enterFrame` (each parent is an earlier
  element). -/
  shapeOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
  /-- §71.1 with the `ok` outcome of §71 ("a new storage root"): exactly one element has no
  parent. -/
  oneRoot : (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1
  /-- §71.2: all leaves of the provider are `Init`. -/
  providerInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init
  /-- §71.2: metadata updates are permitted through exercisable `Modify` on the provider or a
  valid `writeShared` (§68) over its leaves. -/
  providerRight : HasRight s .modify provider ∨
    ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)
  /-- §71.3: exercisable `Modify` over `owner`. -/
  ownerRight : HasRight s .modify owner
  /-- §71.3 (liveness restrictions): `owner` is usable. -/
  ownerUsable : s.Usable owner

/-- Decidability of the static preconditions of `alloc` (§71). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
    (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff (ls ≠ [] ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1 ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (HasRight s .modify provider ∨
      ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)) ∧
    HasRight s .modify owner ∧ s.Usable owner)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩

/-- Places after `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): the elements of the shape appended, owned by
`owner`. -/
def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place :=
  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls.toShape

/-- Effect of `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): a new storage root of fresh identities owned by
`owner`, its leaves `Uninit`, no anchor, alive, unpinned, with a root `Modify` authority with no
origin held by `owner`. -/
def allocEff (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := allocP s owner ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.place owner) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q }

/-- `alloc provider owner shape` as a relation (§71 outcomes, §58): `reject` when a static
precondition fails; `fail`, state unchanged, when `K.Satisfiable` is false; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) :
    Outcome3 S3 → Prop where
  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s owner ls))
  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s .fail
  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject

/-! ## O15 `pin`, O16 `unpin` (§74, §75) -/

/-- Preconditions of `pin` (§74). "Applicable pinning obligations" is not represented. -/
structure PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §74: `place` is usable. -/
  usable : s.Usable p
  /-- §74: exercisable `Modify` over the leaves of `place`. -/

The brief at scratchpad/ref/brief.md does not exist, so I checked obligations 3 and 4 against the summaries in the task and against the spec text.

**What checks out**
- `issue_as_kernel` and `reset_as_kernel` are equivalences in both directions, for every outcome, with the same whole arrival state. Their hypotheses can be met (KInv of the witness state c4 is decided).

- `newArena_as_library` and the per-step ArenaInv preservation lemmas are sound.
- `arena_reuse_safe` and `reset_no_access` have satisfiable hypotheses (block 4 in the r-run), though their content is that authorities are never reactivated.
- The §78.3 witness is valid: its claim that §78.3 follows from §78.2 and I3 is false, shown with an active empty-footprint block anchored on a usable place.
- Repr includes `Machine.Admissible`. R1/R2/R4/R6 are covered for O1–O16 and for newArena/issue/reset. SimRun and LSimRun fix k, C, ObR, ObW, statics and π once per run.
- The four decisions are implemented as stated: declared disjointness = leaf disjointness via DDSound and LayoutWF; empty-region pointer = base of the effective anchor's allocation, with that provenance; region pointer = lowest address among nonzero-size leaves; pointer-size target is a stated hypothesis. H15 and H16 confirm them.
- The layout interface is shown non-vacuous (runD_sim, runZ_sim, runA_sim).

**Findings**
- F1 (major): `lReach_inv` / `lReachNG_inv` assume that every kernel-reachable state has WF3 ∧ NoDangling. That assumption is false under K0, the contract of every witness: I proved it false for statics `st` and for no statics at all. So the library-wide "ArenaInv preserved" theorem is vacuous wherever it is used, and the arena report describes the assumption as provided by the kernel assembly.
- F2 (minor): `pinned_address_stable` does not show that an accepted transfer leaves pinned leaves in place (§82.6 "permitted moves", §63.5, §87). Its address part holds for every operation with no hypothesis, and its transfer case uses no precondition.
- F3 (minor): §76.6 is dropped from newArena with a wrong reason ("WF3 is not decidable"; `Guarded` needs no decidability). On a library-reachable state that violates WF3 and NoDangling, newArena is still ok.
- F4 (minor, spec): the PtrDecided gap (nonempty region whose leaves all have size zero) is recorded, but no concrete example was given. I give one: an ok `store` that the simulation refuses.
- F5 (minor): alignment is missing from LayoutWF, against DESIGN.md and §82.1, and is recorded only as an open item.
- F6 (minor): the `reissue_reads_former_value` docstring calls §86 contradicted, while the report leaves two readings open for arbitration.

At the only instance the file exercises, the theorem holds only because its hypothesis is false. No instance with hK true is shown anywhere. findings.claim: §82.6 asks to 'prove compatibility of permitted moves and pinned-address restrictions'. `pinned_address_stable` proves only two things: a pinned leaf's allocation is not deallocated by free or exit, and its address is unchanged. findings.claim: The two address decisions (empty region → anchor base; otherwise lowest address among nonzero-size leaves) leave the address undefined for a nonempty region whose leaves all have size zero. That case is reachable with an admissible layout. r6_store, StepObl, SimRun, arena_issue and LSimRun all require PtrDecided, so neither R6 for store/issue nor the simulation covers ok kernel steps in this case. The gap is recorded (refinement P5), but without the concrete example AGENTS.md requires. One is given here for arbitration.
findings.evidence: Scratch c5.lean (same directory as F1): run enter [] [3 locals], write 0 [0], alloc 0 1 [(none,0)] with storage 3 laid out at size zero (piOf … [3]), split 3 [[3]]. From the translated state midX, `StoreStep 4 2 midX.1 (.ok …)` holds by decide, but `¬ PtrDecided πX.L midX.1 4` and `(srun … opsX).isSome = false`. All compile.

This departs from DESIGN.md and from §82.1, and is recorded only as an open item, not proposed as a DESIGN.md decision (AGENTS.md: propose decisions DESIGN.md does not settle). It is defensible given that §16 makes alignment an explicit parameterizable obligation, but it is unrecorded as a design deviation.
findings.evidence: DESIGN.md 'Layout interface': "Their guarantees (in bounds, non-overlapping where the spec requires it, aligned) are hypotheses carried as structure fields". §82.1: "relate P, footprint leaves … to the storage units, offsets, ranges, identities, and alignment constraints". LayoutWF fields: parts, disjoint, within only. reports/refinement.md open item 6: "Leaf/type alignment is not in the layout interface (left to §15.6/§16.5 obligations)".

findings.claim: The Lean docstring asserts that §86 is contradicted. The builder's report treats the sentence as having two readings and asks for arbitration (R2: the sentence only restates O9's Init requirement, under which the witness contradicts nothing). The Lean record therefore commits to reading R1 without saying so. The witness itself is correct.
findings.evidence: Docstring: "This contradicts §86, 'Reissuance does not permit reading a former logical value without the required initialization'". reports/arena.md: "Arbitrate: confirm that the sentence only restates O9 (reading R2 of the mapping), or add a reset effect ending the values of the storage leaves". §66.1/O9 asks only that the leaf be Init, and r8.kern.I 1 = .init.
